# AIS-OPS-02

**Are model calls traced with prompts, outputs, tokens and cost, to the GenAI conventions?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | OPS: Running AI |
| Default severity | minor |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `operations.observability.conventions`, `operations.observability.traces` |

## Rule

operations.observability.traces is true and conventions names the GenAI conventions and their version. Where model.hosting is managed-platform, conventions may instead name the platform's telemetry, provided it records prompts, outputs and cost per call, and a decision records the gap from the GenAI conventions.

- OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (Development status) (`otel-genai`)
